answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 13451 Country: United States of America Title: Assalam alaikum.. can women wear gold in her feet (eg. toe-rings)?? Question: Assalam alaikum.. can women wear gold in her feet (eg. toe-rings)?? Answer ID: 13451 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1294/1017=H/1430) They can wear, but it should not resemble the structure of rings worn particularly by non-Muslims women. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
